name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/quartz-posthog
description: Quartz 5 plugin: PostHog analytics that honours Do Not Track, with navigation events labelled by where the reader clicked. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Every entry has its type declarations beside it, which build.mjs emits: Quartz's generated plugin index skips a package without dist/index.d.ts, and a TypeScript site imports the types from them. ./package.json is how Quartz reads the manifest (import.meta.resolve).
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copy, never bundled or installed here. Imported for types only.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: esbuild bundles dist/ (build.mjs). @chaoticgoodcomputing/declarations writes the .d.ts beside each entry (build.mjs), and is a `workspace:*` spec like every library of ours, which `pnpm publish` rewrites to the published version (ADR-0005).

quartz.name: cgc-posthog
